title: Childhood, Adolescence & Adulthood
summary: Development across childhood (early and middle), adolescence (puberty, identity) and adulthood (early, middle, late), including physical, cognitive and social-emotional changes.
revision: Development across childhood, adolescence and adulthood: physical, cognitive and social-emotional changes.
traps: Childhood: 2-11 years; Adolescence: 11-18 years; Adulthood: 18+ years.

i: Early childhood (2–6): play, preoperational thought, initiative
Middle childhood (6–11): school, concrete operational thought, industry
Cognitive: formal operational thought, abstract reasoning

notes.t: UGC NET frequently asks about developmental changes across childhood, adolescence and adulthood.

mnemonics.title: CAA
mnemonics.text: C — Childhood (play, school), A — Adolescence (puberty, identity), A — Adulthood (intimacy, generativity, integrity)
